raw_segments.text: Stubborn, he said, and annoyed. Ah, it is consistent. I put my request in an absurd,
almost insolent form. Miss Eyre, I beg your pardon. The fact is, once for all, I don't
wish to treat you like an inferior. That is, correcting himself. I claim only such superiority
as must result from twenty years' difference in age and a century's advance in experience.
This is legitimate, at J. I. Tynes, as Adele would say. And it is by virtue of this superiority,
and this alone, that I desire you to have the goodness to talk to me a little now,
and divert my thoughts, which are galled with dwelling on one point, cankering as a rusty nail.
